main_text.head: Prateritum plusq; perfectum.
main_text.p: Ego volueram, tu volueras, ille voluerat. Ich, du, er, hatte, hatteft gewolt.
Nos volueramus, vos volueratis, illi voluerant, Wir hatten, jhr hattet, fie hatten gewolt.
main_text.head: Futurum.
main_text.p: Io vorrò, ego volam, ich werde.
Tu vorrai, tu voles, du wirft.
Colui vorrà, ille volet, er wird wollen.
Noi vorrèmo, nos volemus, wir werden wollen.
Voi vorrete, vos voletis, jhr werdet wollen.
Coloro vorranno, illi volent, fie werden wollen.
main_text.head: Imperat. mod. Tempus praf.
main_text.p: Vogli tu, velis tu, wolle du,
Voglia colui, velit ille, wolle er.
Vogliate voi, velitis vos, wollet jhr.
Vogliono coloro, velint illi, wollen fie.
main_text.head: Optat. modi, temp. fut. & praesent.
subjunctivus.
main_text.p: Iddio voglia, che io voglia. Vtinam ego velim. Wolte Gott daß ich woll.

page.notes: Brace marks beside the groups ("volute.") are rendered inline; the decorative stains and show-through are omitted. Catchword and signature not visible. The final word "Ebe." is a faint printed mark, possibly a signature-like catchword; uncertain.
